maddeler.e:
نترعرع (form IIq)
# نَتَرَعْرَعُ (nataraʕraʕu) /na.ta.raʕ.ra.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَرَعْرَعَ (taraʕraʕa)
# نَتَرَعْرَعَ (nataraʕraʕa) /na.ta.raʕ.ra.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَرَعْرَعَ (taraʕraʕa)
# نَتَرَعْرَعْ (nataraʕraʕ) /na.ta.raʕ.raʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَرَعْرَعَ (taraʕraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
